cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I taught you your first waltz; I can get you beyond counting out loud tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought two tickets. My friend is expecting dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring her. You're finally ready to lead someone who isn't telling you where to put your feet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She leads. I promised to follow for once.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. I'll clear my living room and keep my mouth shut. You can show me whether that listening lesson took.

reason: Make the competing birthday offer use A supposed dance training; B reverse-role promise causes A to offer a silent learning demonstration instead of imposing its lesson.
